plain: How much authority an instruction carries, based on how far the system trusts its source.
eli5: Mum's rule beats your big brother's rule because mum is in charge.
technical: The rank an instruction gets from its source in an instruction hierarchy (Wallace et al. 2024: system above user above tool output); ManyIH (2026) generalises this to many tiers written into the prompt, where a tier is one distinct privilege level.
